title: CovidXrayNet: Optimizing data augmentation and CNN hyperparameters for improved COVID-19 detection from CXR

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】We evaluated CovidXrayNet on two datasets, including our generated balanced COVIDcxr dataset (960 CXRs) and the benchmark COVIDx dataset (15,496 CXRs).

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】To mitigate the spread of the current coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, it is crucial to have an effective screening of infected patients to be isolated and treated.

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】With only 30 epochs of training, CovidXrayNet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 95.82% on the COVIDx dataset in the three-class classification task (COVID-19, normal or pneumonia).

evidence.text: To mitigate the spread of the current coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, it is crucial to have an effective screening of infected patients to be isolated and treated.
With only 30 epochs of training, CovidXrayNet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 95.82% on the COVIDx dataset in the three-class classification task (COVID-19, normal or pneumonia).

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《CovidXrayNet: Optimizing data augmentation and CNN hyperparameters for improved COVID-19 detection from CXR》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】In this paper, we optimize the data augmentation and the CNN hyperparameters for detecting COVID-19 from CXRs in terms of validation accuracy.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】This optimization increases the accuracy of the popular CNN architectures such as the Visual Geometry Group network (VGG-19) and the Residual Neural Network (ResNet-50), by 11.93% and 4.97%, respectively.

evidence.text: In this paper, we optimize the data augmentation and the CNN hyperparameters for detecting COVID-19 from CXRs in terms of validation accuracy.

This optimization increases the accuracy of the popular CNN architectures such as the Visual Geometry Group network (VGG-19) and the Residual Neural Network (ResNet-50), by 11.93% and 4.97%, respectively.
